scripts.diff: STACK=$STACK npm run cdk diff -- --app "npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts src/stacks/$STACK/app.ts"
scripts.deploy: STACK=$STACK npm run cdk deploy -- --app "npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts src/stacks/$STACK/app.ts"
scripts.destroy: STACK=$STACK npm run cdk destroy -- --app "npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts src/stacks/$STACK/app.ts"
